lawHalf.laddersAreNotComparable: the three levels are three DIFFERENT ladders; `syntactic`, `resolved-target` and `checked` are not rungs of one global scale. A rung from another relation ladder is refused rather than ranked.

qualifying.why: a fact whose resolution IS the atom rung witnesses the atom, and the relation Coverage for that rung is retained, so the atom is decided rather than unknown

insufficient.why: a fact at a LOWER rung of the same ladder does not witness an atom whose minResolution is higher: ladder position is the only order, and there is no global rank that would let another relation rung stand in
insufficient.missingCoverageIsUnknownNotFalse: composition section 9 strong Kleene: with no matching fact AND no relation Coverage the atom is UNKNOWN. A vacuous false would be a fabricated negative finding.
